title: Vihusishi (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child shows where a thing is or how two things are related with the right relating word, and the -a of agreement that suits the noun.

floor.prerequisite: Uses juu ya and ndani ya.
floor.question: Kitabu kiko ___ ya meza.

representations: a box and a ball placed in, on, under, beside
a table of -a forms (wa, cha, la, ya, za)
steps: Look at where the thing is.
Choose the -a form for the first noun.

board.do: Point at the ball under the chair.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child places the ball three ways and writes a sentence for each.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi katika sentensi: "Kitabu kiko juu ya meza."" Kwa nini "meza" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kihusishi hueleza uhusiano wa nomino na neno lingine, kama "juu ya", "chini ya" na "ndani ya". "Meza" ni nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu ___ mwalimu kiko mezani." Kwa nini "wa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kihusishi cha "a" hubadilika kulingana na ngeli: kitabu cha, vitabu vya, mlango wa, milango ya, jina la, majina ya, nyumba ya.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Samaki wanaishi ___ ya maji, si nje yake." Kwa nini "juu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: "Ndani ya" na "nje ya" ni vinyume. "Juu ya" na "chini ya" ni vinyume pia.

misconceptions.ask: Kalamu ni mtu aliyeandamana naye au ni chombo?
misconceptions.repair: Chombo cha kufanyia kazi huchukua kwa: kwa kalamu. Mtu aliyeandamana huchukua na: na mama.
